title: Ebola outbreak in DRC the fastest growing in the history of the virus

paragraphs.en: The latest numbers of confirmed cases of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has made this latest outbreak the fastest growing in the known history of the virus.
paragraphs.zh: 刚果民主共和国埃博拉确诊病例的最新数字，使这轮疫情成为该病毒已知历史上增长最快的一次。

paragraphs.en: At 3,360 confirmed cases , the disease is now affecting people in five provinces in the east of the DRC, with 1,487 deaths recorded, representing an overall case fatality rate estimated at about 45%, according to Congolese health officials. Health responses to the outbreak have been badly hampered by conflict in many of the affected areas.
paragraphs.zh: 据刚果卫生官员称，该病目前确诊3360例，已影响刚果（金）东部五个省份的人民，记录在案的死亡人数为1487人，总体病死率估计约为45%。受冲突影响地区的卫生应对工作受到严重阻碍。

paragraphs.en: “I fear that at some point, life may come to a standstill here in our province of Ituri,” said Deborah Nzuva, a mother of four who lives in Rwampara, one of the affected regions. “We were already in a precarious situation before the Ebola virus disease, which continues to claim its victims.”
paragraphs.zh: “我担心在某一天，我们伊图里省的生活会陷入停滞，”住在受灾区之一拉姆帕拉、育有四个孩子的母亲黛博拉·恩祖瓦（Deborah Nzuva）说。“在埃博拉病毒病出现之前，我们的处境本已岌岌可危，而它仍在不断夺走受害者。”

paragraphs.en: Since officially declared by the Congolese authorities on 15 May, the Bundibugyo strain of the virus has spread faster than any of the country’s 16 previous Ebola outbreaks – and the numbers are approaching the previous worst toll, in 2018-2020 when 3,470 people in DRC were infected.
paragraphs.zh: 自5月15日刚果当局正式宣布以来，布恩迪布焦型埃博拉毒株的传播速度超过了该国此前16次埃博拉疫情中的任何一次——而且感染人数正接近2018年至2020年那场最严重疫情的人数，当时刚果（金）有3470人感染。

paragraphs.en: Prof Pierre Akilimali, from the country’s public health institute (NPHI), is in charge of the Ebola response. He emphasises that the disease continues to spread and that it is still difficult to know when it will reach its peak. According to him, there is a way to go and the road to bringing the outbreak under control is a long one.
paragraphs.zh: 来自该国公共卫生研究所（NPHI）的皮埃尔·阿基利马利教授负责埃博拉的应对工作。他强调，这种疾病仍在持续传播，目前仍难以知道何时会达到峰值。在他看来，前路漫漫，控制疫情的道路还很长。

paragraphs.en: “Here in Ituri, we have the issues of insecurity, mining and high population density, which make the current outbreak more complex than previous ones,” he said.
paragraphs.zh: 他说：“在我们伊图里省，存在安全问题、采矿问题和高人口密度问题，这使得当前疫情比以往任何时候都更加复杂。”

paragraphs.en: The Congolese authorities say they have taken a number of measures to limit spread, including strengthening surveillance through community liaison officers, building more than 20 Ebola treatment centres, and setting up local laboratories for testing. “The public must also play their part by seeking medical advice at the slightest suspicion of infection,” Akilimali said. “This will help us to respond effectively to the disease.”
paragraphs.zh: 刚果当局表示，他们已采取多项措施来限制传播，包括通过社区联络官加强监测、建设20多个埃博拉治疗中心，以及建立本地检测实验室。“公众也必须尽自己的一份力，一旦有任何感染的怀疑就立即就医，”阿基利马利说。“这将帮助我们有效应对这种疾病。”

paragraphs.en: He said cases continue to rise in the Bunia and Rwampara health zones, with between 100 and 150 new confirmed infections each week.
paragraphs.zh: 他说，布尼亚和拉姆帕拉卫生区的病例数仍在上升，每周新增确诊病例100至150例。
